description: Agent slot record for one GEO position by slug (e.g. '19-2e' for 19.2E, '101w' for 101W). Operator identity is operatorMix, with raw source strings on each share. operatorIdentity is split when more than one canonical operator is in the occupancy window, single when one is, none when the window has no attributed operator. Also returns occupancy observations (tleEpoch and tleStale), FCC authorizations, dispute records, ituRecorded, and source vintage (tleEpochMin, tleEpochMax, tleStale, tleStaleAfterDays 45), with provenance on occupancy, UCS, FCC, license, and rights. tleStale is true only for a TLE that supplied occupancy and is older than 45 days. UCS fallback does not invent a TLE epoch. ITU filings are not in this product. ITU Space Explorer is the current ITU source. SNS Online shut down in January 2025 (ituRecorded is not_in_product). TLE longitude is a tracked position, not an FCC or ITU assignment.
name: clarke_get_slot
